'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[2025 Gaza City offensive]]
***At least 37 [[Palestinians]] are killed from [[IDF|Israeli]] attacks on the [[Gaza Strip]], including 30 in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/22/live-israel-keeps-pummeling-gaza-as-support-grows-for-palestinian-state (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***[[Hamas]] releases a video giving a sign of life for hostage Alon Ohel, who was kidnapped during the [[October 7 attacks]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/hamas-releases-propaganda-video-of-hostage-alon-ohel/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/hyzolcajgx (YNet)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Zaporizhzhia strikes (2022–present)|Zaporizhzhia strikes]], [[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] strike [[Zaporizhzhia]] with at least ten [[glide bomb]]s, killing three people and injuring two others. The overnight attack damages at least 15 [[apartment]] buildings and ten private homes in residential areas of the city. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attack-zaporizhzhia-kills-three-governor-says-2025-09-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**A bomb explodes at a [[Pakistani Taliban]] compound in the [[Tirah Valley]] in [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]] during a raid, killing at least 24 people, including ten civilians and fourteen militants. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-explosion-stored-explosives-northwest-84d9838d6c3b7a6c3e0e07282406eaf8 (AP)] [https://www.dw.com/en/pakistan-more-than-20-killed-during-raid-in-border-region/a-74099053 (DW)]
*[[Islamist insurgency in Niger]]
**An [[airstrike]] near a market in Injar, [[Tillabéri Region]], [[Niger]], kills at least 30 people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/airstrike-kills-least-30-near-market-western-niger-sources-say-2025-09-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Disciplinary actions for commentary on the assassination of Charlie Kirk]]
**[[Suspension of Jimmy Kimmel Live!|Suspension of ''Jimmy Kimmel Live!'']]
***[[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] parent company [[Disney]] announces that [[United States|American]] [[late-night talk show]] ''[[Jimmy Kimmel Live!]]'' will begin airing again on Tuesday after it was "indefinitely suspended" last week following pressure from the [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] after host [[Jimmy Kimmel]] commented on [[Assassination of Charlie Kirk|slain]] [[Right-wing politics in the United States|right-wing]] political activist [[Charlie Kirk]] and his fanbase. [https://www.npr.org/2025/09/22/nx-s1-5550330/jimmy-kimmel-back-suspended-disney-trump (NPR)]

'''Business and economy'''
*Stocks in [[Kenvue Inc.]] fall by 5% after the [[second Trump administration]] issues statements citing [[acetaminophen]] under their brand name [[Tylenol (brand)|Tylenol]] as a [[cause of autism]]. [https://finance.yahoo.com/news/tylenol-maker-kenvue-stock-lost-185855115.html (Fortune)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 European heatwaves]]
**''[[Nature Medicine]]'' publishes a report that [[Europe]] had over 62,700 [[heat illness|heat-related deaths]] in 2024, with women and elderly people representing the largest part of the death toll. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/europe-had-over-62-700-heat-related-deaths-in-2024-report-finds/ar-AA1N4o9I?ocid=winp1taskbar&cvid=68d1703b64bc43a4ba75984e71c87ab4&ei=9 (MSN)]
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Ragasa]] makes landfall in [[Luzon]], [[Philippines]], killing at least three people and leaving six others missing, and triggering alerts and [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] orders in nearby [[Hong Kong]] and southern [[China]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/09/22/asia/super-typhoon-ragasa-philippines-hong-kong-intl-hnk (CNN)] [https://news.az/news/death-toll-from-super-typhoon-ragasa-in-philippines-climbs-to-3 (News.az)]
*Twenty-five [[Mineral industry of Colombia|miners]] are trapped about {{convert|80|m|ft}} underground after a [[gold mine]] collapses in [[Segovia, Antioquia|Segovia]], [[Antioquia Department|Antioquia]], [[Colombia]], with authorities confirming contact, stable health conditions, and ongoing rescue operations. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/colombia-rescuers-race-to-rescue-25-trapped-in-collapsed-gold-mine-owned-by-canadian-firm/ (AFP via CTV News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2020–2025 H5N1 outbreak]]
**[[Poland]] reports an outbreak of highly pathogenic [[H5N1]] [[avian influenza]] on [[Poultry farming|poultry farms]] in [[Susz]], [[Warmian–Masurian Voivodeship]], where around 4,000 birds have died. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/poland-reports-bird-flu-outbreak-farms-north-woah-says-2025-09-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Causes of autism]]
**[[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[United States Secretary of Health and Human Services|health sectretary]] [[Robert F. Kennedy Jr.]] announce the [[U.S. Food and Drug Administration]] will advise doctors against recommending [[acetaminophen]] to pregnant women, alleging a link between the drug and [[autism]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/09/22/health/trump-autism-announcement-cause-tylenol (CNN)]
**The U.S. Food and Drug Administration approves [[leucovorin]] for the treatment of [[cerebral folate deficiency]], citing evidence that it can improve autistic features. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/fda-approves-drug-that-trump-due-suggest-autism-treatment-2025-09-22/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International recognition of Palestine]]
**[[Andorra]], [[France]], [[Luxembourg]], [[Malta]], [[Monaco]], and [[San Marino]] formally recognize the [[State of Palestine]] as a sovereign state with full rights. [https://www.reuters.com/world/live-france-formally-recognize-palestinian-state-two-state-solution-summit-2025-09-22/ (Reuters)] [https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/israel-france-palestine-un-09-22-25#cmfvkmj4p0000356ob3dtalwh (CNN)]
*[[Israel–Singapore relations]]
**[[Singapore]] announces targeted sanctions on leaders of [[Israel]]i [[Israeli settlement|settler groups]], citing concerns over [[Israeli occupation of the West Bank|settlement expansion]] in the [[Israeli occupation|occupied]] [[Palestinian territories]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/singapore-sanction-israeli-settler-leaders-supports-palestine-statehood-2025-09-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Burkina Faso]], [[Mali]], and [[Niger]]  (the [[Alliance of Sahel States]]) announce their withdrawal from the [[International Criminal Court]], citing its ineffectiveness. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20250922-niger-mali-and-burkina-faso-icc-withdrawal (AFP via France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Ecuadorian conflict (2024–present)|Ecuadorian conflict]]
**Fourteen people are killed, including a guard, 14 others are injured and inmates escape during clashes between rival gangs at a jail in [[Machala]], [[El Oro Province]], [[Ecuador]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4gkwdzld23o (BBC News)]
**About 1,000 protestors attack and destroy most of a police station along with vehicles and the houses of officers in [[Otavalo (city)|Otavalo]], [[Imbabura Province]], Ecuador. Two people are injured. [https://apnews.com/article/protesta-violencia-policia-indigenas-ataque-incremento-precio-diesel-c9b984004de09876aaa2a1e29fb0ec9d (AP)]
*[[International Criminal Court investigation in the Philippines]]
**The [[International Criminal Court]] (ICC) charges former [[President of the Philippines|Philippine president]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] with [[crimes against humanity]] for his alleged involvement in the killing of at least 76 people during his term as president and [[Davao City]] [[Mayor of Davao City|mayor]]. He was arrested in March under an ICC [[arrest warrant]] and is currently held in a [[Detention (confinement)|detention]] facility in [[the Netherlands]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/09/23/g-s1-90024/icc-charges-former-philippine-president-duterte-crimes-against-humanity (NPR)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cg5e1v85lrdo (BBC News)]
*[[List of executive orders in the second Trump presidency|Executive orders in the second Trump presidency]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] signs an [[executive order]] formally designating [[Antifa (United States)|Antifa]] as a [[List of designated terrorist groups|terrorist organization]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-signs-order-designating-antifa-terrorist-organization-2025-09-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Copenhagen Airport]] in [[Denmark]] and [[Oslo Airport, Gardermoen|Oslo Airport]] in [[Norway]] are both closed and all flights are diverted after multiple "large drones" are sighted near the airports. It is unclear where the drones originated from or who is operating them. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn4lj1yvgvgo (BBC News)] [https://www.timesnownews.com/world/europe/copenhagen-oslo-airport-airspace-shut-after-drone-sighting-article-152876018 (Times Now)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Guinean constitutional referendum]]
**Provisional results show that over 90% of voters in [[Guinea]] approve a [[Constitution of Guinea|constitutional]] change that permits members of the [[2021 Guinean coup d'état|ruling junta]] to seek the [[List of presidents of Guinea|presidency]] and extend term limits, amid opposition boycotts and criticism that the process consolidates [[Republic of Guinea Armed Forces|military]] power. [https://apnews.com/article/guinea-referendum-results-ff250763a11978489553a129e9653330 (AP)]
*[[2025 Moldovan parliamentary election]]
**[[Moldova]]n [[Moldovan Police|police]] conduct 250 raids and detain 74 people as part of an investigation into an alleged [[Russia]]-supported plan to provoke unrest before the [[Parliament of Moldova|parliamentary]] election, with officials stating that suspects received training in [[Serbia]] while Russia denies involvement. [https://apnews.com/article/moldova-russia-arrests-plot-election-293ee902e878ce1efcca339759eb06d0 (AP)]
*[[Human rights in Egypt]]
**[[Egypt]]ian [[President of Egypt|president]] [[Abdel Fattah el-Sisi]] grants a [[presidential pardon]] to activist [[Alaa Abd El-Fattah]] after he was detained in 2015 and re-arrested in 2019 for participating in [[2019 Egyptian protests|unauthorized protests]]. Abd el-Fattah was expected to be released in September 2024 after his 5-year [[sentence (law)|sentence]] ended but was continuously detained until now. [https://www.dw.com/en/egypt-pardons-jailed-activist-alaa-abd-el-fattah/a-74095862 (DW)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/egypts-president-sisi-pardons-high-profile-egyptian-british-activist-alaa-abd-el-2025-09-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Costa Rica]]n [[President of Costa Rica|president]] [[Rodrigo Chaves Robles]] survives a [[Legislative Assembly of Costa Rica|congressional]] vote to lift his [[Absolute immunity|immunity]], falling short of the required majority, after prosecutors accused him of [[abuse of power]] in a [[Corruption in Costa Rica|corruption]] case. [https://www.bssnews.net/news/314516 (AFP/BSS)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 Ballon d'Or]]
**In [[association football]], [[Football in France|French]] player [[Ousmane Dembélé]] and [[Football in Spain|Spanish]] player [[Aitana Bonmatí]] are awarded their first [[Ballon d'Or]] and third consecutive [[Ballon d'Or Féminin]], respectively. [https://www.thedailyjagran.com/sports/ousmane-dembele-wins-ballon-dor-2025-in-mens-category-aitana-bonmati-creates-history-with-third-successive-title-10268868 (''The Daily Jagran'')]
*[[2025 CFL season]]
**[[Canadian Football League]] (CFL) commissioner [[Stewart Johnston]] announces significant changes to the rules and playing field of the CFL, to take effect in starting in the 2026 and 2027 season, respectively. [https://www.tsn.ca/cfl/article/cfl-announces-changes-to-playing-surface-modified-rouge/ (TSN)]
*In [[ski mountaineering]], [[Polish people|Polish]] climber [[Andrzej Bargiel]] becomes [[List of Mount Everest records|the first person]] to complete a continuous [[List of ski descents of eight-thousanders|ski descent]] of [[Mount Everest]] without [[supplemental oxygen]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/first-climber-ski-everest-no-extra-oxygen-andrzej-bargiel/ (CBS News)]
